reviews.x: I've never used 'beard oil' before, so just for the helluvit decided to give some a try, and grabbed the trial pack (original scent).  The Oil: At first I thought, "wow, this smells very 'real'"; as in, not an artificial, obviously fake smell. It was pretty strong, and ever-present. I was like, "hmmm, not bad, but also not sure if I want to smell like this to others". Didn't take long at all before I pretty much hated the scent. It's very 'cedar' like, I guess you could say. Sort of like you are

I ordered the trial pack and picked 4 different oils. They come in small little draw string bags with a small balm and oil container. Some of my bags had labels and one did not This is my take on some of the scents.  The Biker- very light patchouli The Viking- earthie, wood The Patriot- mild vick’s vapor rub The Outlaw- hints of ginger and spice  The oil rubs in great and isn’t greasy after you apply it. Leaves your beard shiny and moisturized. My favorite was The Viking and my gf loved the Outl

reviews.t: The patriot is his favorite smell. Very masculine smell
reviews.x: I have been buying these for gifts for my hubby so far he has 3. The ladies man, the patriot and royal knight. The patriot is his favorite smell. Very masculine smell. I personally like the ladies man the best. But overall they are a great product!

reviews.t: Hopefully I don't figure out how to eat it.
reviews.x: Excellent beard care products from a great company. I tried this scent hoping it was what I expected it to be and it is or is at least close. There's no scent I love more, in beard products, than a light citrus with an even lighter vanilla. When I saw the name is "Ladies Man" I had a feeling it would be what I was looking for since every woman I've ever known loves a light sweet citrus with vanilla. If I had to say what it smells most like it would a fresh fruity but sweet cake icing. A

I got this for my SO birthday. He has had a beard as long as I known him, but never got into the realm of extensive beard care. So, I thought I'd surprise him with this tiny package to start off. He absolutely loves it! Great set to start off with, especially if you are not sure where to begin with beard balms/shampoo/ECT.
I did not get what I expected out of this order. I got more! Stickers and guitar picks and beard wash, oh my. This company puts out great products.
just barly enought oil for 1 use total waste of money

reviews.t: Smells better on than in the bottle
reviews.x: Omg. Smells different on my husband than in the bottle. At first it was, oh, nice, slightly pine-y, maybe something else in there? Then he rubbed it in his beard... The pine-y turned into a soft evergreen Tahoe breeze with sweet citrus notes and little kiss of the spicy clove- which I couldn’t identify at first, it just registered as yummy. I don’t know what else they sneak in this stuff, but it’s good, really good. The beard had been annoying the crap out of me, now all of a sudden I can’t keep

I ordered the El Burrista to try for my husband. His goatee and mustache hair is of a medium course texture and graying a little bit. The beard oil has made his beard hair softer, less course and he has said the skin underneath isnt as dry. The beard wax allows him to shape his goatee into a neat, tidy look. He says its easy to incorporate into his morning routine. A free sample of the beard wash was included but unfortunately as much as I like the scent, he didnt favor the tea tree oil smell. I

I ordered two trial sets from this company, one of here and one on their website, the one on the website coming with a free beard/hair wash as well. I got three scents, Brewmaster, El Burrista and Royal Knight. Besides Burrista the other two didn’t smell like what they were described as(fruity beer, and vanilla earl grey). The Burrista smelt really good though, just like coffee beans.  This was my first time using beard oil/balm so was excited but after a few uses I feel underwhelmed. The beard

reviews.t: It’s good stuff!! Stops the itch.
reviews.x: I am a newly retired vet so had to give this a try since its vet owned. I just received the Patriot sampler with their beard wash as well and fellas I dig it! After shaving almost every day for the last 23 years I am new to this whole beard thing and have already tried several of the other popular brands, but the wife hated the smell and the beard wash was lack luster. Well.....the wife likes the smell and I dig the product so I’m sticking with this brand. Going to try the sampler of all the sce

reviews.t: Great balm for a soft good looking beard
reviews.x: The sent is very mild, just what I was looking for. I didn't want something too strong as I am growing my beard out longer and had not used beard balm before. The sample was plenty to get a bunch of uses and helped to control flyaway hairs.  The packaging is fantastic. The little black velvet bag it comes in and the guitar pick to dig out the balm are really cool . You get a great beard oil sample with it too.  I have now purchased two more samples of beard balms in different scents. Great value

This is my favorite scent so far! It's a bit of citris with a plant greenery thrown in. This scent is the strongest to me out of the four I bought. (the other being The Pirate, The Ladies Man, and The Royal Knight.)  Like all of theses samples I've seen a great benifit to my beard after use. I used to have a short, itchy, and dry beard that was rife with dandruff. I was causing patchy-ness due to all my scratching pulling my hairs out. Now my beard to shiny, fuller, dandruff free, and no longer

I ordered the sample of the royal knight. It came with a beard wash. Tried the beard wash seems to do its job. The oil was great. It was absorbed by my beard and didnt leave my hands greasy. I only tried the balm once. It's very creamy and soft. My only complaint and it's more of a preference than a actually issue about the product. It's the scent it's not my my cup of tea. Best way to describe the scent is opening a brand new box of fruit pebbles or froot loops.  That's why I gave the scent 3 s

My husband loved this smell. My husband is a softer man. Likes his soft smells. He suffers from bad allergies and this scent DID NOT agitate them. He works night shift and he said it is a nice smell for the calm quite shifts. He loved the quality of the product. He is mixed race and his hair texture is very tight. He said it made the hair soft enough to brush out without brakage or tears. I also got a matching scent "hog wash" he loved loved loved it! A little of this stuff goes a long way

This is my first exposure to beard oil and wax and I've been very pleased with both so far.  Smells great, works well, and easy to apply. Ordered several of their trial packs so I can figure what scent(s) I'd like to purchase in larger quantities.  Very happy with the size of these, with several days worth of usage to get a good feel for the product. And the price point is great for trying this out, rather than sinking a larger chunk of change into something you may not care for.

Not being paid for this by them at all, just honestly impressed af at their packaging and the product itself. First off, I order the trail too test it out. Got here fast and I mean fast. Comes in a little pouch, a thank you card with a guitar pick attached logo on it. And I got a free 1oz bottle of peppermint beard wash. Smells fan f’in tastic, feels fan f’in tastic. Smells like freedom and f you  terrorism. They’ve just won my beard business.

Bought the Patriot scent trial and my boyfriend loved it! He's been growing his beard out and was very excited that this was a three-piece set. It smells wonderful and doesn't linger in a bad way. His beard feels softer and doesn't look as frizzy as it did. This trial came with a beard wash, a mini bottle of oil, a small container of balm, a pick, and three stickers. Will be purchasing a full-sized set for him in the near future.

I got this sample pack as part of a gift for my dad I opened it to see what all was included and to smell each item. Both my dad and I are coffee drinkers so I thought the el barista would be a good pick. I absolutely love the smell it’s amazing and if he likes it as much as I did I’ll probably get him a full size set. Also I loved that the logo was right on the package. Great product.

reviews.t: The coolest sample pack we've ever seen!!!
reviews.x: My husband was so excited to get this in the mail. What a cool kit!! They included several samples in small pouches with the logo, and even a sticker and a guitar pick!! Awesome!! Can't wait to order one of these for my brother in law. Will definitely be ordering full sized products soon. Thanks for making this so nice, and giving guys something to have that is cool and fun!!

reviews.t: first of all love the fact it got here quick
reviews.x: first of all love the fact it got here quick. Love the way it smells and makes my beard feal. Like getting the sample packs to what smells I do or do not like. I was also surprised to get the beard shampoo to. Which is bye far my most favorite item bye them. That little bottled lasted two weeks. So not only was all of it worth it. But I have soft beard that smells great!

We ordered the sample size, and it came with beard wash! My husband was afraid the strong scent of the wash would over power the more subtle scent of his oil, but the smell of the wash doesn't linger!! His beard is so soft, and when he straightens it, he's noticed it's taking less time, and less heat to get the job done. My man is convinced! We are buying the full size!!

The scent was not for me, however, I passed it on to a friend and he loves it! But! I also received a sample of their beard wash, and that was not passed on to anyone! It’s amazing! I would order from BABC again! And can’t wait to check out their other varieties! I love that they have samples so you don’t have to fully commit right away!

reviews.t: Best boalm and Beard Oil I have ever used
reviews.x: I got the kit this past week and used it as soon as I opened it. I wash my beard, dried it and put this beard balm and oil on my beard. It was miraculously soft but held in place. Occasionally I will have stray hairs that just go every which way and this beard oil did the job. Best boalm and Beard Oil I have ever used.

I've liked other Badass products, and this, as far as consistency, is just as good. My only complaint is the scent. The vanilla over powers the sandalwood. I don't dislike vanilla. I used all of the oil, and have used most of the balm, and will likely use the rest. But I would have liked the sandalwood to be stronger.

claims.text: Customers frequently praise the scents as pleasant and masculine, with several naming specific favorites.
Many reviewers say the products leave beards softer, less coarse, and less itchy, and the oil absorbs without greasy hands.
The trial/sample packs are widely described as great gifts and good starter sets, though some find them very small.
A few reviewers note that some scents did not match their descriptions or expectations.
Reviewers appreciate the packaging and extras like stickers, guitar picks, and beard wash included with orders.
